name: Agent Utilities
description: Validate and reshape supplied HTML, JSON and shopping data with 60+ deterministic tools: GTIN check digits, whole-pack price planning, OpenAPI diffs and security header audits. Keyless MCP and REST.

skills.name: HTML Extraction
skills.description: Extracts main text, metadata, headings, links, tables and JSON-LD from supplied HTML via html.main-text, html.metadata and html.jsonld.

skills.name: JSON Transforms
skills.description: Applies RFC 6902 patches, RFC 6901 pointer selection, canonical serialization and bounded diffs via data.json-patch, data.json-pointer and data.json-diff.

skills.name: API Contract Checks
skills.description: Lints OpenAPI 3.0 documents, detects breaking changes between versions and validates data against JSON Schema 2020-12 via contracts.openapi-lint and contracts.openapi-diff.

skills.name: Security Header Audit
skills.description: Audits response headers, CSP directives and Set-Cookie attributes, decodes JWT claims and scans for credential patterns via security.header-audit and security.secret-scan.

skills.name: Commerce Pricing
skills.description: Validates GTIN check digits, plans lowest-cost whole-pack combinations and compares unit prices via commerce.gtin-validate, commerce.pack-plan and commerce.unit-price.
